fields.label: App ID
fields.description: Stable backend app identifier, for example seedfit. Adding a brand here does not configure backend authentication.

fields.label: Customer ID Prefix
fields.description: Exact prefix before the numeric Shopify customer ID, for example seedfit:gid://shopify/Customer/. Must match the backend; leave empty until configured.

fields.label: QuickLink Channel Account
fields.description: Legacy provenance mapping only. Not used by mobile-owned QuickLink.

fields.label: QuickLink AI Settings
fields.description: Mobile App owns these chats. AI credentials are configured only on the shared backend.

fields.label: Main Instructions
fields.description: Role, tone and language. These instructions cannot grant access to private records.

fields.label: Human Handoff Rules
fields.description: Tell the assistant when to suggest the Contact care team button. Clicking it pauses AI and opens a support ticket.
